Sample_treatment_protocol_ch1: For heat shock treatment, cells were incubated in a water bath at 44 °C for 10 min. For transcription inhibition, cells were treated with 25 or 750 µg/mL rifampicin for 40 min at 37 °C and 200 rpm. To induce DNA damage, cells were exposed to 70 µg/mL bleomycin for 10 min at 37 °C and 200 rpm. For DNA gyrase inhibition, cells were treated with 0.025 or 0.25 µg/mL ciprofloxacin or 25 or 250 µg/mL novobiocin for 15 min at 37 °C and 200 rpm. For netropsin treatment, cells were grown to an OD600 ~ 0.4, followed by the addition of netropsin to a final concentration of 20 or 200 µg/mL and incubation for 30 min at 37 °C and 200 rpm.
Sample_growth_protocol_ch1: E. coli K-12 MG1655 strain was grown in Luria-Bertani broth at 37 °C and 200 rpm until reaching an OD600 of ~ 0.6.
Sample_extract_protocol_ch1: Cells were fixed with 3% formaldehyde and 2 mM DSG followed by treatment with lysozyme. DNA was digested with MNase. DNA ends were labeled with biotin and ligated followed by removal of biotin from non-ligated ends by Exonuclease III. The sample was de-crosslinked at 65 °C in the presence of Proteinase K followed by phenol-chloroform extraction and ethanol precipitation. RNA was removed by RNase A treatment and DNA was further purified with AMpure XP beads. Downstream steps included sonication, biotin pull down, end repair, A-tailing, ligation of Illumina Y adapters, and PCR amplification.
Sample_data_processing: The raw reads were processed with distiller-nf pipeline using NC_000913.3 E.coli reference genome and BWA as an aligner.

Sample_treatment_protocol_ch1: For heat shock treatment, cells were incubated at 44 °C for 10 min. For transcription inhibition, cells were treated with 25 or 750 µg/mL rifampicin for 40 min. For antibiotic treatment cells were treated with the indicated concentration of the drug for 40 min.
Sample_growth_protocol_ch1: E. coli K-12 MG1655 strain was grown in Luria-Bertani broth at 37 °C and 200 rpm until reaching an OD600 of ~ 0.6.
Sample_extract_protocol_ch1: Cells were resuspended in 250 µL TE (10 mM Tris pH 8.0, 1 mM EDTA) supplemented with 1× protease inhibitors (Bimake) followed by adding lysozyme (Sigma L6876) to 4 µg/mL and incubating for 30 min at 37 °C with shaking at 1000 rpm. The sample was pelleted for 5 min at 16100 g and room temperature and resuspended in an appropriate volume of MNase buffer (10 mM Tris pH 7.5, 1 mM CaCl2) followed by adding MNase (ThermoFisher EN0181, used as 5 U/µL stock solution) to 10 U/mL and incubating for 25 min at 37 °C with shaking at 1000 rpm. The volume of MNase buffer ranged from 475 to 1160 µL for different samples; it was determined individually for each sample to obtain the fragment distribution from ~ 75 to 1000 bp. DNA digestion was terminated by adding EGTA to 5 mM followed by centrifugation for 5 min at 16100 g and room temperature.
The libraries were prepared following a modified Micro-C protocol
